comparison.explanation: From 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-15, the clicked pixel changed by HH +1.48 dB, HV +3.00 dB.

radar.comparator: Target minus median of the prior measured dates

evidence.interpretation: Groups compare optical water classes at two snapshots. Mixed cells are descriptive.

comparison.claim: New strict open water between the two optical snapshots in the comparison cell containing the point.

HH.reason: Both comparison groups require measured support

HV.reason: Both comparison groups require measured support

signature_policy.interpretation: Evidence states refer to measured signatures or the explicitly named optical claim.

surrounding_comparison.definition: Change in a 60 m focal patch minus change in unique baseline-level matched cells 120–300 m away.

matches.criterion: unique baseline co-/cross-pol levels within declared dB tolerance; at most 128 nearest candidates; contrast uses matched positives only; not causal matching on all confounders

HH.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established

HV.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established

differential_darkening.claim: Focal-minus-control mean change is at most -3 dB co-pol and -1.5 dB cross-pol.

water_comparison.claim: New strict open water between the two optical snapshots in the comparison cell containing the point.

HH.reason: Both comparison groups require measured support

HV.reason: Both comparison groups require measured support

observation.reason: Sensor error and speckle uncertainty are unestimated.

model.reason: Diagnostic thresholds have no fitted probability model.

questions: Did both radar channels darken relative to this pixel's observed baseline?
Did a baseline-matched surrounding population change differently from the focal patch?
Do independently dated optical snapshots show new water or water already present?

spectral.reason: Need at least six observed dates

stochastic.reason: Need five measured dates for a lens GP

visualizations.title: Polarization RGB · HH/HV
visualizations.interpretation: False color combines co-pol return, cross-pol return and their balance. Roughness, structure, moisture and viewing geometry can all influence these channels.

visualizations.title: Polarization balance · HV/HH
visualizations.interpretation: Cross-pol minus co-pol in dB. A change in this balance can come from either input channel.

visualizations.title: Change in polarization balance · HV/HH
visualizations.interpretation: Later cross/co log ratio minus earlier cross/co log ratio. Both channels must be supported on both dates.

components.label: Later minus earlier HV/HH log ratio

visualizations.title: Temporal median · HH
visualizations.interpretation: Cellwise median over the listed observations on complete per-channel support.

visualizations.title: Temporal variability · HH
visualizations.interpretation: Scaled median absolute deviation across the listed observations. This is observed variability in dB.

visualizations.title: Three-date RGB · HH
visualizations.interpretation: False color assigns three observed dates to red, green and blue. Equal returns across dates produce gray.

visualizations.title: Temporal median · HV
visualizations.interpretation: Cellwise median over the listed observations on complete per-channel support.

visualizations.title: Temporal variability · HV
visualizations.interpretation: Scaled median absolute deviation across the listed observations. This is observed variability in dB.
